source: Urban et al. 2012, Particle Morphology and Size Results from the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-2, AIAA 2012-3536 (42nd ICES), Table 1 'Diameter results for baseline runs for each material'. NTRS 20130000422.
note: Sizes are NASA's (SAME-2 flight, baseline runs at 8 cm/s). Mass shares below each detector limit are our lognormal calculation from them. Sources disagree on where light-scattering detectors lose sensitivity, so the limit is a control (300, 500, 1000 nm), not a fixed fact.
